cases.question: How many annual leave days do full-time employees get?
cases.answer:
Northstar Labs is a fictional company. These policies are original demonstration data, not employment or legal advice. Full-time employees receive 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Part-time employees receive a pro-rated allowance based on contracted working days. Public holidays do not reduce the annual leave allowance. [S1]

An employee may carry over up to 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year. Carried-over days expire on 31 March of that next year. People Operations maintains the authoritative leave balance in PeopleDesk; this policy does not contain individual balances. [S2]

evidence.text:
Annual Leave Policy | Scope and allowance
Northstar Labs is a fictional company. These policies are original demonstration data, not employment or legal advice. Full-time employees receive 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Part-time employees receive a pro-rated allowance based on contracted working days. Public holidays do not reduce the annual leave allowance.

Annual Leave Policy | Carryover and records
An employee may carry over up to 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year. Carried-over days expire on 31 March of that next year. People Operations maintains the authoritative leave balance in PeopleDesk; this policy does not contain individual balances.

Annual Leave Policy | Requests and approval
Submit annual leave in PeopleDesk at least 10 working days before the first day away. The line manager approves requests after checking team coverage. Requests for more than 10 consecutive working days also require approval from the department head.

Annual Leave Policy | Version note
Version 2.0 supersedes version 1.0, document NS-HR-001-OLD. Use this current version for current policy questions. Sick leave, parental leave, and country-specific statutory entitlements are outside the scope of this demonstration policy.

New Employee Onboarding Checklist | Equipment allowance
The home-office allowance eligibility starts after 30 calendar days of employment. Refer to NS-HR-002 for the USD 300 allowance, eligible items, and approval requirements. The onboarding buddy may help with navigation but cannot approve access or expenses.

Remote Work and Equipment | Availability
Employees must be available during team collaboration hours of 10:00–15:00 in their assigned office time zone, excluding their normal meal break. Availability does not mean continuous meetings. Employees record planned remote days in TeamCalendar.

Remote Work and Equipment | Equipment and security
The one-time home-office equipment allowance is USD 300 per employee, available after the employee completes 30 calendar days of employment. Obtain line-manager approval before purchase and submit itemized receipts through SpendDesk. The allowance covers an external keyboard, mouse, monitor, or ergonomic desk accessories. Personal broadband subscriptions are not covered. Use the company-managed laptop for company work and follow NS-IT-001 for multi-factor authentication and remote access. Remote work from another country requires prior review by People Operations; this policy does not specify permitted countries.

Business Travel and Expenses | Booking and daily limits
Book economy-class flights. Hotel reimbursement is capped at USD 180 per night before tax. Meals are reimbursed at actual cost up to USD 60 per travel day, including tax and tips. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Unused daily meal allowance cannot be carried to another day.

Annual Leave Policy | Version note
Version 2.0 supersedes version 1.0, document NS-HR-001-OLD. Use this current version for current policy questions. Sick leave, parental leave, and country-specific statutory entitlements are outside the scope of this demonstration policy.

Annual Leave Policy | Requests and approval
Submit annual leave in PeopleDesk at least 10 working days before the first day away. The line manager approves requests after checking team coverage. Requests for more than 10 consecutive working days also require approval from the department head.

Annual Leave Policy | Carryover and records
An employee may carry over up to 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year. Carried-over days expire on 31 March of that next year. People Operations maintains the authoritative leave balance in PeopleDesk; this policy does not contain individual balances.

Northstar Labs is a fictional company. Current approved policy documents are the evidence source for the knowledge assistant. A superseded document is retained for history and must not determine a current-policy answer. When the indexed documents do not establish a fact, say that the available documents do not provide it and name the appropriate team when that team is known from evidence.

Atlas Product Plans and Data Export | Retention and pricing
Enterprise retention can be configured from 30 to 365 days. This demonstration document does not specify a default retention period. Product pricing, service availability commitments, and roadmap release dates are not published in this corpus.

evidence.text:
IT Access and Security Standard | Security incidents
Report a suspected security incident immediately through the Security Incident form in ServiceDesk. If ServiceDesk is unavailable, call the internal Security hotline listed in the employee directory. This document intentionally does not provide a telephone number. Preserve relevant evidence and do not attempt your own investigation.

IT Access and Security Standard | Access requests
Request application access through ServiceDesk. The line manager confirms the business need and the application owner approves the requested role. IT provisions approved access. Standard approved access requests have a target of 2 working days; this is a service target, not a guaranteed completion time. Use the minimum role needed for the task.

IT Access and Security Standard | Remote access and restricted data
Use a company-managed laptop. Connect to the company VPN before accessing internal-only systems from outside the office. Do not upload restricted company data to personal cloud storage or unapproved AI services. No passwords, API keys, or authentication tokens belong in support tickets or assistant questions.
